svg.title: E42 posterior trajectories and the ICS-209 containment check
svg.desc: Twelve small multiples, two rows of six fires. Row 1: each fire's learned p0 posterior (median and cross-seed sd band) over days since the first mask, with day 1 and day 5 marked. Row 2: the model containment curve, built from every member's final genome run against the fire's observed growth, against ICS-209's reported percent contained, with a dot at each curve's 50 % crossing day.
svg.text: ROW 1: LEARNED p0 POSTERIOR (MEDIAN ± SD, 5 SEEDS) · ROW 2: MODEL CONTAINMENT CURVE VS ICS-209, DOTS AT 50 % CROSSING
